dt-example.title: Ajax loaded states
dt-example.info:
We've already seen [how to provide prepopulated states](./main.html) on the client-side, but it is also possible to have the states list populate from the Ajax request DataTables makes when the `-init ajax` option is set.
To do this, in the object returned by the server include a `stateRestore` object which should be an array with `-type StateRestore.Predefined` objects in it.
In this case, two simple states are added automatically to the list of states, and the end user can select from these as they need.
